headline: REVIEW: 'Women in Blue' Season 2 is a More Confident and Ambitious Crime Drama
excerpt: Season 2 proves that Women in Blue has more to say than its initial premise suggested. Feels bigger, darker and more confident. By Isadora Wandermurem.

headline: 'Las Azules' regresa a Apple TV con una segunda temporada marcada por la masacre estudiantil mexicana de 1968
excerpt: Maria, ya teniente, investiga el asesinato de una activista estudiantil que conecta con Tlatelolco 1968. Por Pau Mora, VerTele.

headline: Las Azules regresan con una segunda temporada que sacudira los cimientos de la historia
excerpt: Entrevistas exclusivas con Rovzar y Mori. La segunda temporada arranca con una fuerza demoledora. Por Mavi Gangi.

headline: Las Azules temporada 2: Todo lo que necesitas saber
excerpt: Entrevistas con Natalia Tellez y Ximena Sarinana. Tellez: Esta luchando por fuera todo lo que no puede luchar por dentro. Por Lucia Corona.

headline: WOMEN IN BLUE (LAS AZULES) S2 Review: Two Steps Forward, One Step Back
excerpt: Season 2 feels more on-point and certain of its tone than Season 1, exploring police corruption through Mexico's first female officers. Reviewer Peter Martin praises the show for being more relevant today, far beyond Mexico's borders, while noting occasional melodramatic twists.

headline: Apple TV 'Women in Blue' Season 2 Episode 1 Review - The System is Still Rotten
excerpt: Episode 1 establishes a politically charged investigation tied to Mexico's 1968 student massacre, with Maria's promotion to lieutenant introducing internal conflict about fighting corruption from within a broken system. By Anjali Sharma.

headline: 'Las Azules' demuestra que los heroes son gente como cualquier otra: Ximena Sarinana, Barbara Mori y Fernando Rovzar
excerpt: Entrevista con Ximena Sarinana, Barbara Mori y Fernando Rovzar sobre la temporada 2: el legado de las primeras policias de Mexico y los nuevos conflictos institucionales que definen la narrativa.

headline: Women in Blue Season 2 Is Now Streaming on Apple TV
excerpt: Season 2 of the Spanish-language crime drama is now streaming on Apple TV, featuring eight weekly episodes through September 30, 2026. By Rajat Saini.

headline: 'Las Azules' Season 2 Episode 2 Release Date and Time on Apple TV
excerpt: Episode 2 arrives August 19, 2026 at midnight Eastern, with weekly episodes continuing through the September 30 finale. By Tena Milakovic.

headline: Barbara Mori y Ximena Sarinana hablan de 'Las Azules' temporada 2
excerpt: Barbara Mori y Ximena Sarinana hablan del desarrollo de sus personajes y la nueva direccion narrativa de la segunda temporada de Las Azules en Apple TV+.

headline: 'Las Azules' Recap Revisits a Defiant Season 1 Finale as Season 2 Arrives on Apple TV+
excerpt: S1 recap and S2 preview. Rovzar framed S2 as a chance to test characters against a genuinely difficult moral landscape. By Robert Milakovic.

headline: Las Azules: la segunda temporada vuelve al Halconazo
excerpt: Rovzar, Mori y Sarinana explican como retrataron el Halconazo de 1971 y la censura en la segunda temporada. Por Ivett Salgado Mendez.

headline: Women in Blue's second season premieres on Apple TV
excerpt: Apple TV subscribers can now stream Season 2 of the Spanish-language crime drama. Eight episodes follow the female officers investigating a case connected to 1968, confronting systemic corruption. By Marcus Mendes.

headline: Apple TV series 'Las Azules' Season 2 blends fact and fiction for tale of corruption and growth
excerpt: Reuters feature by Hanna Rantala on how Season 2 blends historical events with fiction, four officers navigating corruption and the lingering shadows of Mexico's student massacres in eight weekly episodes.

headline: Las Azules persiguen las sombras del poder
excerpt: La temporada 2 expande la narrativa mas alla de perseguir a un asesino serial para explorar la corrupcion institucional y las secuelas del Halconazo. Rovzar explica que el antagonista ahora es el sistema entero.

headline: Women in Blue Season 2 Is Coming Next Week: Everything You Need to Know
excerpt: Pre-premiere Apple ecosystem guide: plot, cast, release schedule, what to expect from Season 2. By Rajat Saini.

headline: 'Women in Blue' Season 2 premiere: Apple TV's Spanish-language series returns August 12, 2026
excerpt: Premiere guide for Apple TV's female-led crime drama returning August 12, 2026 with eight weekly episodes investigating a conspiracy linked to the 1968 student massacre. By Sajin Shrijith.

headline: Show Guide: Women In Blue (aka Las Azules)
excerpt: Comprehensive show guide for both seasons. S2 shifts to student activist murder connected to 1968 massacre. By Rick Ellis.

headline: 'Las Azules' Season 2 trailer teases a deadly conspiracy
excerpt: The Season 2 trailer reveals a chilling new mystery with a deadly killer and a conspiracy reaching back to the 1968 student massacre. Debuts August 12 on Apple TV+. By Zehra Phelan.

headline: Women in Blue (Las Azules) Season 2 Trailer and Key Art
excerpt: Official Season 2 trailer and key art reveal. Maria now lieutenant investigating student activist murder. Premieres August 12. By Mirko Parlevliet.

headline: LAS AZULES Season 2 Trailer Arrives Ahead of August Premiere on Apple TV
excerpt: Apple TV unveiled the official Season 2 trailer for the Spanish-language crime drama about Mexico's first female police force, centered on a deadly conspiracy with roots in a painful historical event. By Joshua Wright.

headline: Women in Blue (Las Azules) Season 2 Sets August Debut
excerpt: Apple TV confirms August 12, 2026 premiere date for Season 2 of the 100% RT crime drama. Eight weekly episodes through September 30.

headline: 'Women In Blue' (Las Azules) Season 2 Gets August Premiere On Apple TV+
excerpt: Apple TV+ announced August 12, 2026 premiere for Season 2, following four women who became Mexico's first female police force in 1971 investigating a new case tied to 1968. By Veronica Villafane.
